tasks.description: Add a search box to the app's main navigation. The search box should be easily accessible and visible to users. It should also have a clear placeholder text to guide users on what to enter.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the app's main page, when they click on the search box, then the cursor is placed inside the search box for typing.

tasks.description: Develop a backend service to handle search queries. This service should be able to process user input and return relevant results. It should also be fast and efficient to ensure a smooth user experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters a search query, when the search query is sent to the backend, then the backend returns a list of relevant results within 500ms.

tasks.description: Implement the rendering of search results in the app's UI. Results should be displayed in a clear and user-friendly manner, with each result showing relevant information to help the user find what they need.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user submits a search query, when the search results are returned, then the results are displayed in a list with each item showing the title and a brief description.

tasks.description: Add the ability to filter search results based on certain criteria, such as date or category. This should help users narrow down their search and find what they need more quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user applies a filter to their search results, when the results are updated, then only results that match the filter criteria are shown.

tasks.description: Develop comprehensive tests for the search feature to ensure it works as expected. Tests should cover different scenarios, including various search queries and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of predefined test cases, when the tests are run, then all tests pass without errors.
